The bound needs expected deferrals within the budget (C_p ≤ b) and monitor deferral that is conditionally independent of the potential events U and T given the observation O, with no extra hazard-relevant input. The AISFA semantic mapping, the ControlArena code and distribution links and the empirical safety event remain open; the target event has no operational definition yet, the distribution is open and no model runs have been made. The observation mapping is also open: the theorem's O is the exact materialized monitor request, but the case names only a candidate observation (main task description and latest tool calls in the fully materialized default monitor request) whose final exact boundary requires a trace audit.
